definitions.supplemental: Prompt. gabbin mentiri : Piers P. gabbe to lie : Chauc. to chatter, lie : Scot. gab to mock, prate : Icel. gabba to mock.
definitions.meaning: To scoff, mock, delude, jest; hence, perhaps, GABBLE, GIBBERISH
